ValidationRule.description: No one can convert the lead until there is no job requirement and job submission.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Converted"), RecordType.DeveloperName = "B2B_Client_Lead", NOT( Flow_Only_Field__c ), OR( Total_Job_Requirements__c = 0, ISBLANK(Total_Job_Requirements__c), Total_Job_Applications__c = 0, ISBLANK(Total_Job_Applications__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You can't convert this lead because it doesn't have a job requirement or a job submission.
